title: SSR/Next.js Integration & Performance
description: Integrate Apollo Client with Next.js for SSR, SSG, and optimized performance.
longDescription: This module covers integrating Apollo Client with Next.js including SSR with getServerSideProps, SSG with getStaticProps, hydration strategies, performance optimization with selective fetching, and how to avoid common pitfalls when using Apollo in a Next.js application.
whatYouLearn: Set up Apollo Client with Next.js App Router and Pages Router
Implement SSR with getServerSideProps and Apollo
Use SSG with getStaticProps and cache hydration
Optimize Apollo Client performance in Next.js applications
